{{Term/Store|Fire-Proof||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}}<ref name="EoW Game Screen"/> also stylized as {{Term/Store|Fireproof||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Guide"/><ref name="TotK Guide"/> is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}===
Fireproof is a [[Set Bonus]] that prevents [[Link]] from taking any damage from [[Fire]] or Fire-based attacks. It does not protect against damage from [[Extremely Hot Zone]]s, [[Scorching Climate]]s, or [[Lava]].

Fireproof can be found as the [[Set Bonus]] for the [[Flame-Resistant Equipment]] (★★) in both {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}.

==={{EoW|-}}===
In {{EoW}}, Fire-Proof is an [[Added Effect]] that prevents [[Princess Zelda]] from taking damage as a result of [[Fire]] and Fire-based attacks. It can be obtained by drinking [[Smoothie]]s or [[Potion]]s that are made using [[Chilly Cactus|Chilly Cacti]], all of which have "Chilly" in their names.

The following drinks provide Fire-Proof when consumed by Zelda:
